data.name: Khayyir
data.gender_notes: Khayyir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-y-r', which means 'to replace with something better'. In Islamic context, it can be interpreted as a name of Allah, meaning 'The Replacer', or as a name for a good and pleasant person. The name Khayyir carries the meaning “Good, Pleasant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khayyir usually hope their child will grow to embody good, pleasant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the blessings and gifts that Allah has bestowed upon us, inspiring gratitude and devotion
data.etymology: Khayyir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Pleasant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayyir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: خير
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الخيرية و البركة و النعمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خير هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الكثير الخير، الغني عن الحاجة، المتصدق على الفقراء و المحتاجين. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَقضِي عَلى مِسكينٍ فِدكاً'، وقد ذكر اسم خير في الحديث النبوي: 'خيركم من كان أحسنهم خلقا'.

in_hindi.long_meaning: खैर एक हिंदी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है अच्छाई, नेक, या भलाई। मुस्लिम परंपरा में, यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह अच्छाई और आशीर्वाद का प्रतीक है। खैर नाम वाले लोग अच्छे और धार्मिक माने जाते हैं।

in_english.name: Khayyir
in_english.long_meaning: Khayyir is a masculine given name derived from the Arabic root 'kh-y-r', which means 'good', 'benevolent', or 'charitable'. The name is mentioned in the Quran and various hadiths, signifying a person who is generous, kind-hearted, and brings good to others. In Islamic tradition, individuals with this name are considered to embody virtues such as compassion, generosity, and righteousness.
